counters.text: Aunty, I join Monday — salary comes on the 1st. Deposit ₹5,000 now?
The green-gate PG said ₹6,000 rent with food.
My amma will ask if I'm eating properly. Rent ₹6,500, and I'll eat whatever you cook.

lines.concede: Hmm. {term} {amount}, okay. Only because you asked nicely.
lines.hold: No, no. That is already the lowest — ask anybody in the lane.
lines.offended: Two thousand?! Am I selling vegetables? Shanthamma's house is not a sabzi market, ah.
lines.final: That's it — {total}, final. Swalpa adjust maadi.

walkText: Let me see the other places first
